hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys, re
try:
    d = json.load(sys.stdin)
    cmd = d.get('command', '')
    if re.search(r'--no-verify|SKIP=', cmd):
        print('BLOCKED: --no-verify and SKIP= bypass the pre-commit gate and are prohibited.')
        print('Fix the failing hook instead.')
        sys.exit(1)
except Exception:
    pass
"
